description: Quantify occupancy, B-factor and burial of the Ca2+ and Zn2+ sites in the isolated CHAPk domain, and read the crystallisation conditions
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

txt = requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/4CSH.pdb", timeout=90).text
L = txt.splitlines()

# Crystallisation conditions / source of the metals
print("=== 4CSH crystallisation and metal provenance (REMARK 280 / 200) ===")
for ln in L:
    if ln.startswith("REMARK 280") and ln[11:].strip():
        print(ln[11:].rstrip())
print()
# occupancy and B of each metal
rows=[]
for ln in L:
    if ln.startswith("HETATM") and ln[17:20].strip() in ("CA","ZN","NA"):
        rows.append(dict(ion=ln[17:20].strip(), chain=ln[21], resi=ln[22:26].strip(),
                         occ=float(ln[54:60]), B=float(ln[60:66])))
M=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("=== Metal occupancy and B-factor in 4CSH ===")
print(M.groupby("ion").agg(n=("occ","size"), mean_occupancy=("occ","mean"), mean_B=("B","mean")).round(2).to_string())

# protein mean B for comparison
pb=[float(l[60:66]) for l in L if l.startswith("ATOM")]
print("\nProtein mean B = %.1f A^2" % np.mean(pb))
print("Ratio metal B / protein B:",
      {i: round(M[M.ion==i].B.mean()/np.mean(pb),2) for i in M.ion.unique()})

# solvent accessibility proxy: count protein heavy atoms within 8 A of each metal (burial)
atoms=[(l[17:20].strip(), l[21], l[22:26].strip(), float(l[30:38]), float(l[38:46]), float(l[46:54]), l[:6].strip())
       for l in L if l.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM"))]
A=pd.DataFrame(atoms, columns=["resn","ch","resi","x","y","z","rec"])
prot=A[A.rec=="ATOM"][["x","y","z"]].values
def burial(ion):
    out=[]
    for _,r in A[(A.resn==ion)&(A.rec=="HETATM")].iterrows():
        d=np.linalg.norm(prot-np.array([r.x,r.y,r.z]),axis=1)
        out.append(int((d<8.0).sum()))
    return out
bCa, bZn = burial("CA"), burial("ZN")
print("\nProtein heavy atoms within 8 A (burial proxy): Ca2+ %s (mean %.0f) ; Zn2+ %s (mean %.0f)"
      % (bCa, np.mean(bCa), bZn, np.mean(bZn)))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(14.5,4.3))
ax=axes[0]
ax.bar(["Ca2+","Zn2+"],[M[M.ion=="CA"].occ.mean(), M[M.ion=="ZN"].occ.mean()],
       color=["#2f855a","#b7791f"]); ax.set_ylim(0,1.15); ax.set_ylabel("Refined occupancy")
for i,v in enumerate([M[M.ion=="CA"].occ.mean(), M[M.ion=="ZN"].occ.mean()]): ax.text(i,v+0.02,"%.2f"%v,ha="center")
ax.set_title("Metal occupancy, 4CSH", fontsize=10)

ax=axes[1]
ax.bar(["Ca2+","Zn2+","protein"],[M[M.ion=="CA"].B.mean(), M[M.ion=="ZN"].B.mean(), np.mean(pb)],
       color=["#2f855a","#b7791f","#718096"]); ax.set_ylabel("Mean B-factor (A^2)")
for i,v in enumerate([M[M.ion=="CA"].B.mean(), M[M.ion=="ZN"].B.mean(), np.mean(pb)]): ax.text(i,v+0.4,"%.1f"%v,ha="center")
ax.set_title("Order of each metal site", fontsize=10)

ax=axes[2]
ax.bar(["Ca2+","Zn2+"],[np.mean(bCa),np.mean(bZn)], color=["#2f855a","#b7791f"])
for i,v in enumerate([np.mean(bCa),np.mean(bZn)]): ax.text(i,v+2,"%.0f"%v,ha="center")
ax.set_ylabel("Protein heavy atoms within 8 A")
ax.set_title("Burial: Ca2+ is enclosed, Zn2+ sits at the surface\nof the catalytic cleft", fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

M.to_csv("lysK_CHAPk_4CSH_metal_sites.csv", index=False)
print("\nSaved lysK_CHAPk_4CSH_metal_sites.csv")
